notice.title: Engagement of Authorized Doctor on Contract Basis with Monthly Remuneration at FGMO Bengaluru Advertisement

registration_deadline.evidence: The applications from eligible candidates should reach the Chief Manager, FGMO Bengaluru, Indian Bank, 4th Floor, Raheja Towers, East Wing, 26-27, M.G Road, Bengaluru-560001 on or before 05:00 PM of 20.02.2025

clauses.text: Candidates should have a minimum of 10 years’ experience (post qualification experience) in any hospital or as Medical Practitioner
Mere fulfilling the eligibility criteria does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview
Educational Qualifications:(Indicate degree / diploma obtained, In the order of highest to least)
Attested copies of certificates regarding ID & Address proof, age, educational qualifications, experience etc. should accompany the application

negative_marking.value: Half of the marks assigned for each wrong answer
